description: One agent's mistake consumed by the next and the next, gaining apparent credibility at each hop.
Keeping an output that failed validation out of downstream context, with the reason recorded.
Agents converging on an answer because they saw each other's opinions, not because they checked independently.
The share of all voters an answer needs to win. Abstentions count against it.
Multi-Agent System failure Taxonomy: 14 failure modes in three categories (system design, inter-agent misalignment, task verification), from 1,600+ annotated traces.
A check before each delegation: no cycles, maximum depth, maximum fan-out per delegator and a maximum total per run.
